_about: sovring MCP server: copy the block for your client. Replace /home/you with your home directory (clients do not expand ~ or $HOME in args); the server is .mcp/server.py inside your clone of https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing. Needs only python3 (3.8+) and git. Clones land in SOVRING_HOME.

claude_code._how: one command: claude mcp add sovring -e SOVRING_HOME=$HOME/sovring -- python3 $HOME/sovring/SovRing/.mcp/server.py   — or put the block below in .mcp.json at your project root

claude_desktop._how: claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit Config); use absolute paths

zero_install._how: no clone, read-only docs (no tests run): add this remote MCP URL in any client that supports remote MCP servers
